name: pokecrystal-typescript-monorepo
description: ASM-faithful Pokemon Crystal recreation in TypeScript

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:cli && npm run build:web
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @pokecrystal/core && npm run build --workspace @pokecrystal/assets && npm run build --workspace @pokecrystal/exporters && npm run build --workspace @pokecrystal/cli && npm run build --workspace @pokecrystal/agents
scripts.build:cli: npm run build --workspace @pokecrystal/cli && npm run build --workspace @pokecrystal/agents
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @pokecrystal/core -- --runInBand && npm run test --workspace @pokecrystal/assets && npm run test --workspace @pokecrystal/exporters && npm run test --workspace @pokecrystal/cli -- --runInBand && npm run test --workspace @pokecrystal/web -- --runInBand
scripts.pack:dry-run: npm pack --dry-run --workspace @pokecrystal/core && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @pokecrystal/assets && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @pokecrystal/exporters && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @pokecrystal/cli && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @pokecrystal/agents
scripts.release:check: CI=1 npm run build:packages && CI=1 npm run test:core && CI=1 npm run test:assets && CI=1 npm run test:exporters && CI=1 npm run test:cli -- --runInBand --ci && CI=1 npm run test:agents -- --ci && npm run pack:dry-run
scripts.typecheck: npm run lint:types --workspace @pokecrystal/core && npm run lint:types --workspace @pokecrystal/assets && npm run lint:types --workspace @pokecrystal/exporters && npm run lint:types --workspace @pokecrystal/cli && npm run lint:types --workspace @pokecrystal/web
scripts.play:recorded: npm run build --workspace @pokecrystal/cli && node apps/web/scripts/run-with-bundled-node.js packages/cli/dist/bin/pokecrystal-cli.js play-recorded
scripts.release:prep: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run release:check
